name: available, rent quoted well above the listing

turns.text: Hello — I'm an AI assistant calling for a tenant about your listing in Kondapur. This will take under a minute, and I am recording it so she can hear your answers. Is that alright?
When can she come and see the flat?
Anytime, today evening also possible. After six is best, the current tenant has already moved out.
What's the rent and the deposit right now?
Rent is thirty-two thousand, deposit three months. Listing is showing twenty-eight but that was old, owner increased it.
So thirty-two thousand rent and three months deposit — correct?
Is there a brokerage on top, and how much?
Is non-veg allowed in the building?
Non-veg no problem, this building is mixed.
Does the owner rent to bachelors, or is it family only?
Owner prefers family, but working women he is okay with. Bachelors, boys, that he will not do.
That's everything, thank you. She'll call you back directly if it fits.
